MIDLAND.gloss: the interior part of a country
MIDLAND.definition: The interior part of a country.

LIMAN.gloss: a long narrow lagoon near the mouth of a river
LIMAN.definition: A long narrow lagoon near the mouth of a river.

MIND.gloss: that which is responsible for one's thoughts, feelings, and conscious brain functions
MIND.definition: That which is responsible for one's thoughts, feelings, and conscious brain functions; the seat of the faculty of reason.

LAND.gloss: the land on which real estate is located
LAND.definition: The land on which real estate is located.
LAND.example: He built the house on land leased from the city.

MAIL.gloss: the bags of letters and packages that are transported by the postal service
MAIL.definition: The bags of letters and packages that are transported by the postal service.

MAN.gloss: an adult person who is male
MAN.definition: An adult person who is male (as opposed to a woman).
MAN.example: There were two women and six men on the bus.

ADD.definition: Make an addition (to); join or combine or unite with others; increase the quality, quantity, size or scope of.
ADD.example: We added two students to that dorm room.

DAD.gloss: an informal term for a father
DAD.definition: An informal term for a father; probably derived from baby talk.

AID.gloss: a person or thing that is a resource that helps make something easier or possible to do
AID.definition: A person or thing that is a resource that helps make something easier or possible to do.

MAD.example: Stayed huffy a good while"- Mark Twain.

LAID.gloss: set down according to a plan
LAID.definition: Set down according to a plan.
LAID.example: A carefully laid table with places set for four people.

AIM.gloss: point or cause to go towards
AIM.definition: Point or cause to go (blows, weapons, or objects such as photographic equipment) towards.
AIM.example: Please don't aim at your little brother!

MIN.gloss: a unit of time equal to 60 seconds or 1/60th of an hour
MIN.definition: A unit of time equal to 60 seconds or 1/60th of an hour.

NAIL.gloss: attach something somewhere by means of nails
NAIL.definition: Attach something somewhere by means of nails.
NAIL.example: Nail the board onto the wall.

DAM.gloss: a barrier constructed to contain the flow of water or to keep out the sea
DAM.definition: A barrier constructed to contain the flow of water or to keep out the sea.
